diagnoses.summary: pe-uk 2.132.6 has no Growth Plan SDLT relief: its 2024-25 schedule already equals the pre-relief world, so removing the relief changes nothing. The relief was law from 23 September 2022 to 31 March 2025.
The relief ended on 31 March 2025, so modern law from 2025-26 is the pre-relief world. The OBR's later costings of the increase are offset by its separate 'ending the Growth Plan change' measure.
The counterfactual keeps the relief from 2025-26, the first year the measure changes; the OBR's 2024-25 yield is timing around the end date, which an annual construction does not express.

diagnoses.summary: The OBR's costing is net of the self-employed incorporating in response: its NICs yield falls from £570m (2019-20) to £475m (2021-22) while income tax goes from -£60m to -£420m and corporation tax rises to +£340m. A static run has no such response. PolicyEngine's NICs leg alone (+£0.68bn in 2024-25) is 1.27 times the OBR's NICs row scaled to the modern base (£0.475bn x 1.131).
